```{r sra-metadata-merge, eval=FALSE}
# Merge the SRA metadata downloaded to resources/ on Savio.
# SraRunInfo.csv: one row per Run (SRR). sra_result.csv: one row per Experiment
# (SRX). Enrich each run with its experiment-level metadata; keep every run,
# even when its experiment is missing from sra_result.csv.
# eval=FALSE for now; set to TRUE to run.

repo_root <- "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/moi_lab_projects/custom-rag-cli"
sra_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "resources")

runinfo <- read.csv(file.path(sra_dir, "SraRunInfo.csv"))
result <- read.csv(file.path(sra_dir, "sra_result.csv"))

# Every run should be unique; sra_result.csv can repeat an experiment row,
# so deduplicate defensively and report how many were dropped.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(runinfo$Run))
dropped <- sum(duplicated(result$Experiment.Accession))
result <- result[!duplicated(result$Experiment.Accession), ]

# Columns kept from sra_result.csv. read.csv turns "Total Size, Mb" into
# "Total.Size..Mb"; Library.Strategy / Library.Selection also exist in the run
# table, so the per-run values win and are not re-imported with a prefix.
experiments <- result[, c(
  "Experiment.Accession", "Experiment.Title", "Organism.Name", "Instrument",
  "Submitter", "Study.Accession", "Study.Title", "Sample.Accession",
  "Sample.Title", "Total.Size..Mb", "Total.RUNs", "Total.Spots", "Total.Bases",
  "Library.Name", "Library.Source"
)]
names(experiments) <- c(
  "exp_accession", "exp_title", "exp_organism", "exp_instrument",
  "exp_submitter", "exp_study", "exp_study_title", "exp_sample",
  "exp_sample_title", "exp_size_mb", "exp_runs", "exp_spots", "exp_bases",
  "exp_library_name", "exp_library_source"
)

sra <- merge(
  runinfo,
  experiments,
  by.x = "Experiment",
  by.y = "exp_accession",
  all.x = TRUE
)

nrow(runinfo)    # runs
nrow(experiments)  # unique experiments
dropped          # duplicate experiment rows dropped
nrow(sra)        # merged rows, one per run
sum(is.na(sra$exp_title))  # runs with no experiment metadata available

dir.create(file.path(repo_root, "results"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(
  sra,
  file.path(repo_root, "results", "sra_merged.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
